content:
alex: PTAL — pushed changes that address @maria's comments about the Request struct rename (req_id -> id). Added a small compatibility shim so older clients don't break, and a one-shot migration script.

alex: Files changed: server/req.go, migrate/20240615_rename_reqid.sh, tests/integration/request_compat_test.go

alex: Ran unit + local smoke: ./scripts/run_smoke.sh --subset=requests — all unit tests passed locally but integration is flaky on CI.

alex: Quick notes in the PR description about rollback and safety flags. PTAL when you have a minute.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions — build ✔, unit tests ✔, integration: flaky (2/3 runs passed). See https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/987654 for logs.

maria: skimmed — shim looks fine. Two asks: 1) add a short comment explaining why we keep both fields, 2) ops prefers migrations in separate PRs so they can review runbooks.

alex: can do. The migration is tiny and idempotent but I can split it out if you prefer. Shim-only PTAL?

sam: I can pick up the migration PR and coordinate with ops for a canary. If you split it, tell me and I’ll schedule.

alex: OK splitting sounds good. I'll remove the migration script from this PR and open a follow-up migration PR with runbook and rollback steps.

alex: For reviewers: to reproduce the flaky integration locally run: 
```
# run the requests subset smoke with retries
./scripts/run_smoke.sh requests --retry 3
```

# sample tail of the failing log for context:
````
WARN integration: transient DB lock encountered, retrying (attempt 2/3)
PASS tests/integration/request_compat_test.go: 12.3s
ERROR integration: timed out waiting for response from worker (120s)
````

maria: thanks — when you open the migration PR ping me and include the ops runbook (rollback steps + expected downtime). Otherwise shim PR looks good.

alex: split done. New PR #2345 created: migrate/20240615_rename_reqid. Link in the main PR description. PTAL @maria @sam :eyes:

ci-bot: deploy-bot — canary slot available 2024-06-15T22:00:00Z if PR merged before 21:30 UTC.

sam: I can take merge ops tonight. One more approval and I'll merge and queue canary.

maria: LGTM from me. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks! tagging release-custodian for merge tonight and adding note to changelog about the shim behavior.

sam: noted — will coordinate the canary and monitor logs for the first hour.

alex: appreciate it — will follow up with brief post-canary checklist.
